question: "A man has to cover a distance of 222 km in 14 hours. If he covers two-third of this distance in 3/7 of the time, then what should his speed (in km/hr) be to cover the remaining distance?"
solution:
**Given:**

Total Distance = 222 km

Total Time = 14 hours

Distance covered in (3)/(7) of time = (2)/(3) of distance

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

Distance for first part = (2)/(3) times 222 = 148 km

Time for first part = (3)/(7) times 14 = 6 hours

Remaining distance = 222 - 148 = 74 km

Remaining time = 14 - 6 = 8 hours

Required speed = 74 ÷ 8 = 9.25 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 9.25 km/hr.**
